description: This is a FastAPI backend module implementing REST APIs for a resume screening application. It includes endpoints for uploading resumes, listing resumes, creating and listing criteria, ranking resumes against criteria, and listing ranked candidates. The code interacts with a database to store and retrieve resumes, criteria, and ranking results, and uses external modules for text extraction and parsing.

methods.description: Uploads a resume file, extracts text and structured fields, and stores in database.
